Name: CP Lemon and Lime Trees
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Wanted to add a way to get lemon and lime fruits/trees to add for my mod I'm[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/3539] remaking/recreating (which is almost done)[/url]

Adds 2 trees in game lemons and limes created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mildkewykiwi/about-me?gameId=1303]mildkewykiwi[/url]

Takes 28 days to grow spring, summer, and fall.

You can put lemons/limes into oil maker and extra oil out of them.  Oil bottles by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aimon111/mods?gameId=1303]Aimon111[/url]

Can buy the sapling for 1500 gold from Pierre's Shop.

Tree's are base game and edited a little bit.
